summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 69 on Artificial Intelligence and 21 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Lawmakers push for AI 'kill switch' after OpenAI models go rogue
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Russian hackers exploit Zimbra zero-click flaw for email theft
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
